# The implementer left a forbidden command. A hit in the latest lane run forces a fix: the scoped fix gets the hit as its findings
# before any review. The scoped review of the clean fix approves, the gate passes, and the full review approves.
exec beehest run 7 --workflow flow/workflow.star
stdout 'item 7 finished'

exec beehest status
stdout '^item-7-r1\tdone\tgate pass at [0-9a-f]+\treview 2/24\t'

grep -count=1 '^plan ' calls.log
grep -count=1 '^implement ' calls.log
grep -count=2 '^review ' calls.log
grep -count=1 '^fix 1 ' calls.log
! grep '^fix 2 ' calls.log

# The fake implementer stages everything. The example forbids it. The fix takes the hit as findings, and the clean fix leaves nothing for either review.
! exists seen.log
grep -count=1 '^fix: bulk-staging: git add -A$' found.log
! grep '^settle ' calls.log

cmp events.log expected-events.log

-- verdicts --
approve
approve
-- expected-events.log --
claim 7
release 7
